title: PROJECT MANAGER
description_text:
Uraian Pekerjaan:

-

- Project Planning & Coordination

- Menyusun project charter, work breakdown structure (WBS), timeline, dan rencana pelaksanaan proyek

- Menyusun rencana kerja pengelolaan database dan kalender webinar.

- Memimpin rapat koordinasi internal dan eksternal dengan PP POGI.

- Memastikan pekerjaan berjalan sesuai ruang lingkup, jadwal, dan anggaran proyek.

-

- Database Management – ± 5.700 Anggota

- Mengelompokkan database berdasarkan wilayah, cabang organisasi, spesialisasi, atau kategori lain yang disepakati.

- Mengawasi identifikasi data duplikat, data tidak lengkap, dan data yang memerlukan verifikasi.

- Memastikan proses validasi, standardisasi, pemutakhiran, dan pembersihan data.

C. Webinar Planning & Scheduling

- Menyusun kalender webinar bulanan, triwulanan, dan tahunan berdasarkan arahan PP POGI

- Mengawasi proses registrasi dan konfirmasi peserta.

- Mengkoordinasikan pembuatan flyer, undangan, materi promosi, dan pengingat peserta.

- Menyusun timeline persiapan setiap webinar.

- Mengkoordinasikan penentuan tema, narasumber, moderator, tanggal, waktu, dan target peserta.

D. Stakeholder Management

-

-

- Menjadi PIC utama proyek dalam komunikasi operasional dengan PP POGI.

- Mengkoordinasikan tim database, administrasi, komunikasi, desain, dan teknis webinar.

- Memastikan setiap perubahan ruang lingkup mendapatkan persetujuan yang diperlukan.

- Menjaga hubungan kerja profesional dengan seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

E. Budget, Quality & Risk Control

-

-

- Mengendalikan anggaran dan penggunaan sumber daya proyek.

- Memantau kualitas database dan ketepatan laporan.

- Mengevaluasi kinerja vendor atau pihak ketiga apabila digunakan.

- Memastikan seluruh deliverables diserahkan sesuai kesepakatan.

F. Reporting & Documentation

-

-

- Menyusun laporan progres mingguan dan bulanan.

- Menyusun laporan status database, termasuk jumlah data tervalidasi, duplikat, belum lengkap, dan perlu ditindaklanjuti.

- Menyusun laporan kehadiran, hasil kegiatan, kendala, serta rekomendasi.

- Menjaga dokumentasi proyek, notulen rapat, persetujuan, dan serah terima hasil pekerjaan.

Qualifications:
- Wanita

- Usia Mak 35 Tahun

- Pendidikan S1 Telekomunikasi

- Memiliki keterampilan analisis dan perencanaan yang kuat;

- Memiliki komunikasi dan presentasi yang baik

- Memiliki keterampilan pemecahan masalah yang sangat baik

- Pengalaman minimal 5-10 tahun

title: Data Platform Engineer
description_text:
About this Position

As a Data Platform Engineer — External Data Acquisition, you will build and operate ASTRO's platform for acquiring data from external sources, including websites, web/mobile applications, APIs, public datasets, and third-party data providers.

A significant part of this role focuses on production-grade web and application data acquisition for pricing and market intelligence use cases. You will own the acquisition layer—from understanding external systems and extracting data to delivering reliable landing data for downstream processing.

Focus: External Data Acquisition · Web & App Scraping · Python · HTTP/API · Data Pipelines · Reliability

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Build and maintain reliable web/app crawlers, scrapers, and external API integrations across e-commerce, marketplace, retail, and other external sources.

- Analyze browser, mobile application, API, and network traffic to understand how data is delivered and design the appropriate acquisition approach and runtime, from direct HTTP/API extraction to browser automation.

- Build acquisition systems that remain reliable as external websites, applications, APIs, and data contracts evolve.

- Handle real-world source complexity such as sessions, tokens, pagination, dynamic content, rate limits, retries, concurrency, and partial failures.

- Build resilient and maintainable acquisition systems with appropriate testing, idempotency, deduplication, retries, safe reruns, data-quality validation, monitoring, and alerting.

- Operate acquisition workloads using appropriate workflow orchestration, compute, data storage/warehousing, and cloud infrastructure.

- Continuously improve reliability, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership, including evaluating build-vs-buy approaches for external data.

- Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development or automation to improve how external-data pipelines are built, operated, and maintained.

- Collaborate with Pricing, Data Warehouse Engineering, Data Analysts, and other stakeholders to turn external-data needs into sustainable platform capabilities.

Qualifications:
In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

- Strong Python/software engineering fundamentals and experience building maintainable production systems.

- Hands-on experience building or operating web scraping, crawling, external API, or similar data acquisition systems.

- Strong understanding of HTTP, APIs, JSON, headers, cookies, sessions, authentication, pagination, and request/response behavior.

- Hands-on experience with browser/network debugging and the ability to investigate how websites or applications communicate with their backend services.

- Experience with both HTTP-based extraction and browser automation, using tools such as Requests/HTTPX, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy, or equivalent.

- Understanding of production reliability patterns such as retry, timeout, rate limiting, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.

- Solid understanding of SQL, data storage/warehousing, schema evolution, workflow orchestration, containerized workloads, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.

- Strong troubleshooting skills, especially when working with frequently changing external systems outside your direct control.

Good to Have

- Experience acquiring data from mobile applications, marketplaces, e-commerce, grocery, food-delivery, or other large consumer platforms.

- Experience with asynchronous or distributed acquisition systems and high-volume crawling.

- Familiarity with proxy infrastructure, data observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.

- Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve data acquisition workflows.

- Experience designing reusable scraping frameworks or shared acquisition platforms.

- Experience with geospatial or other non-traditional external datasets.

title: Data Analyst
description_text:
About This Position

We are looking for a Data Analyst to support the Demand Planning team in improving demand forecast accuracy and reliability. You will analyze sales and demand patterns, develop forecasting logic, and build automated tools and monitoring to support inventory and fulfillment decisions, ensuring customer demand is met just-in-time.

If you enjoy turning data into practical forecasting solutions and working cross-functionally to improve product availability, we would love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

- Demand Forecasting & Business Analysis

- Analyze demand patterns across SKU, hub, category, time period, campaign, price changes, and seasonal/festive events.

- Develop, evaluate, and improve demand forecasting logic, including baseline normalization, seasonality, festive events

- Monitor and analyze forecast-performance metrics

- Identify and investigate sales and demand anomalies, including unusual spikes or drops caused by festive events, trends, pricing changes, or operational disruption.

- Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for Demand Planners and Supply Chain stakeholders.

- Forecasting Logic, Automation & Data Products

- Translate Demand Planning business requirements into scalable data solutions, including datasets, forecasting logic, dashboards, alerts, and automated workflows.

- Build and maintain data models and pipelines supporting demand forecasting processes, including data preparation, normalization, imputation, reporting, and configuration management.

- Automate manual forecasting and monitoring processes using SQL, Python, BigQuery, workflow orchestration/DAGs, and integrations with Google Sheets or reporting tools.

- Develop alerts and trackers to enable timely responses to changes in demand, pricing, anomalies, campaign performance, and availability risk.

- Maintain clear documentation for technical logic, data lineage, source tables, configurations, business rules, and operational runbooks.

- Production Pipeline Ownership & Reliability

- Ensure the reliability and timeliness of daily forecasting pipelines and report-refresh processes.

- Conduct troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and remediation for data-quality issues, pipeline failures, reporting discrepancies, and forecast anomalies.

- Perform manual runs or backfills when required, ensuring workflow sequence and dependencies are executed correctly.

- Work with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to improve the robustness, scalability, and maintainability of forecasting systems.

Qualifications:
Must Have

- Minimum 1–3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Analytics Engineer, Supply Chain Analyst, or in a similar role.

- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets, preferably in BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.

- Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and/or pipeline development.

- Understanding of demand forecasting concepts and evaluation metrics, including baseline, seasonality, outliers, trends, and forecast accuracy metrics.

- Experience building dashboards, automated reports, data pipelines, monitoring tools, or alerts.

- Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and data-validation skills.

- Ability to communicate technical analysis and insights clearly to non-technical business stakeholders.

- High ownership, strong attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple dependencies.

Preferred Qualifications

- Having backgrounds in e-commerce, retail, quick commerce, FMCG, or supply chain related fields.

- Familiar with Airflow/Composer, Git, Google Data Studio, Apache Superset, Google Cloud Platform, or similar tools.

- Exposure to machine-learning forecasting workflows or collaboration with Data Science teams.

- Experience operating and maintaining production data pipelines, including incident handling and backfill processes.

title: Security Engineer
description_text:
1. Carry out Red Team (offensive security) activities such as penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, exploitation, and red team simulations to proactively identify weaknesses in applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

2. Perform Blue Team (defensive security) tasks including continuous monitoring of systems and networks, analyzing alerts from SIEM/IDS/IPS/EDR, and leading security incident detection and response.

3. Develop and fine-tune detection rules, correlation logic, and automation scripts to improve proactive defense and reduce response time.

4. Research latest attack techniques, exploits, and defense mechanisms to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats.

5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (SOC, DevOps, IT, Engineering) to embed security across the SDLC and infrastructure.

6. Document findings, prepare reports, and provide clear remediation guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications:
1. Min. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

2. Min. 1 years of experience in cyber security, with exposure to both offensive and defensive practices.

3. Strong knowledge of penetration testing frameworks (Metasploit, Burp Suite, Kali Linux, Nmap, OWASP ZAP).

4. Hands-on experience with defensive tools: SIEM (QRadar, FortiSIEM), IDS/IPS, EDR (CrowdStrike, Sophos), Firewalls, and WAF.

5. Solid understanding of security frameworks and methodologies (MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Top 10, NIST, ISO 27001).

6. Having Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) Certification is a plus.

title: Android Engineer
description_text:
About Astro

ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced.

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

About this Position

We’re looking for a Freelance Android Engineer (Project Based) to support the development of internal Android applications used by our operations teams. In this role, you’ll focus on building features, fixing bugs, and implementing UI using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. You’ll contribute to clean, maintainable codebases, learn modern Android practices, and grow your technical skills under the guidance of senior engineers at Astro.

Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain Android features for internal operational applications based on product and design requirements.

- Perform bug fixing and minor enhancements with guidance from senior engineers.

- Write clean, maintainable Kotlin code following established Android best practices.

- Build user interfaces using Jetpack Compose and implement designs from Figma.

- Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, and QA teams during feature development.

- Write basic Unit Tests and UI Tests for assigned tasks when required.

- Participate in code reviews, apply feedback, and continuously improve code quality.

- Support application stability and performance, including basic crash monitoring and documentation.

Qualifications:
- Minimum 1 year of experience in Android application development.

- Proficient in Kotlin as the primary programming language.

You will also take ownership of performance profiling, troubleshooting, and optimization across app startup time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering. As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Lead the development, optimization, and maintenance of Android applications, ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, and code quality.

- Profile and optimize Android rendering performance, scrolling behavior, frame rendering time, and main-thread execution to minimize UI jank and frozen frames.

- Collaborate with Product and Design teams to translate UI/UX requirements into polished, high-performance Android experiences.

- Establish performance benchmarks, monitor production metrics, and continuously improve application responsiveness and resource efficiency.

- Lead technical design discussions, break down complex engineering problems into actionable tasks, and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery.

- Take ownership of the full product lifecycle, including development, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.

- Explore and leverage AI tools or technologies to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows, including coding, debugging, refactoring, test generation, and documentation.

- Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and performance before integrating them into production applications.

Qualifications:

- Minimum 3-4 years of experience in software engineering, with strong hands-on experience in native Android application development.

- Strong proficiency in Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development practices.

- Solid experience with Jetpack Compose and/or the Android View system, including advanced UI rendering, animations, transitions, and gesture handling.

- Proven experience identifying and resolving Android performance issues related to application startup, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, frame rendering time, and memory consumption.

- Strong understanding of Android's rendering pipeline, frame deadlines, VSync, main-thread execution, garbage collection, memory allocation, and CPU/GPU utilization.

- Proven ability to build smooth, responsive UI experiences, including complex animations, seamless navigation transitions, optimized scrolling, skeleton loading states, and interactive components.

- Experience optimizing lists, image loading, caching, asynchronous processing, and background operations using technologies such as RecyclerView, Kotlin Coroutines, and Flow.

- Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns, including MVVM or MVI, dependency injection, modularization, and clean code principles.

- Experience with application performance monitoring, benchmarking, production troubleshooting, and regression prevention.

- Practical experience exploring and using AI-powered development tools to improve coding productivity, debugging, testing, refactoring, and other everyday engineering workflows.

- Ability to validate AI-assisted implementations and ensure that generated solutions meet production standards for performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.

- Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, CI/CD, release management, production monitoring, and maintenance.

- Possesses a curious and proactive mindset, continuously seeking feedback, learning new technologies, and exploring better engineering practices to improve application performance and development efficiency.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create seamless user experiences

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for new and existing features.

- Perform manual and automated testing to identify bugs and performance issues.

- Provide detailed analysis of all testing carried out on the environment ensuring all bugs, risks and issues are logged.

- End to end feature test execution.

- Collaborate with the development team to understand application functionality and requirements.

- Report and track defects using issue tracking tools, ensuring timely resolution.

- Conduct regression testing and participate in release cycles to ensure product quality.

- Continuously improve testing processes and methodologies.

- Working with agile methodologies within scrum teams.

What We Offer:

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Opportunities for professional development and growth.

- A collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Qualifications:
Qualifications :

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- Total experience required 1+ years of experience as a QA Engineer (Minimum)

- High attention to detail.

- Have exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills.

- Familiarity with software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality.

- Ability to navigate ambiguity, work independently under pressure, prioritise, can handle multiple projects and stay focused in a fast-paced environment.

- Well-developed verbal and written communication skills, including an ability to develop and deliver constructive feedback on documentation.

Would be a plus:

- Experience with performance/automation testing tools : JMeter, LoadRunner, karate, gatling, selenium, cucumber, katalon

- Knowledge of scripting languages (JavaScript).

- Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.

- Experience with mobile and website UI and UX testing.

title: Product & UX Researcher
description_text:
At Aleph, we design human experiences by asking the right questions. Here, you’d find a curious breed of creative engineers spread across the globe, specializing in craft, strategy, and technology. With a keen ear to the ground, we turn big dreams into user-first digital solutions by design. Through rigorous prototyping, close collaboration, and responsive engineering, we commit to creating a future that leaves our craft, community, and clients better than before.

​​We’re looking for a skilled and curious Product & UX Researcher to join our team and support the revamp of a major banking platform. You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional project squad alongside UI/UX Designers and the client’s Product and Business teams. Your role is to uncover user needs, pain points, and opportunities — and to champion those insights to shape the next generation of banking experiences.

As the team’s Researcher, you will own the end-to-end research process and help guide both product and design decisions. You’ll also contribute to defining post-launch success metrics to ensure the solutions we create have measurable impact. Here are your key responsibilities:

- Collaborate with the internal project squad and the client’s stakeholders to define research goals and select the most effective approaches (interviews, FGDs, participatory design, usability testing, surveys, A/B testing, data analysis, etc).

- Translate business questions into focused research plans and activities that generate actionable insights.

- Lead end-to-end research: plan, recruit, conduct, analyze, and report — including managing research operations for the project.

- Present findings in clear, structured, and compelling formats (e.g., report documents, insight decks, or synthesis frameworks).

- Act as a user advocate in design discussions, participating in ideation and helping shape the UX.

- Co-define product success metrics and performance indicators with the team; help build a framework for ongoing tracking and optimization.

- Ensure all research activities adhere to ethical and legal standards, especially around handling sensitive customer and financial data.

Qualifications:
This role is ideal for you who possess:

- At least 3 years of full-time experience in UX or product research, ideally in client-facing roles or in complex digital environments such as banking, fintech, or other regulated domains.

- Proven ability to run both qualitative and quantitative research independently and collaboratively – from planning, recruiting, conducting, analyzing, reporting, and managing research operations for the project.

- Strong communication and storytelling skills, both in written and verbal formats — able to distill findings and influence both internal and external stakeholders.

- Ability to operate several research tools (e.g., Maze, UsabilityHub), analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude), and data analysis tools (e.g., SPSS, R).

- Comfortable interpreting data from BI tools and product analytics dashboards; familiar with product and UX performance metrics.

- Experienced in facilitating ideation or co-creation workshops using several product frameworks (e.g. JTBD, Value Proposition Canvas, Opportunity Mapping)

- Self-driven, detail-oriented, and passionate about high-quality research and meaningful outcomes.

- Adaptable and resilient — able to work within tight timelines, shifting requirements, and complex stakeholder environments.

description_text:

- Financial-grade app security: certificate pinning, Keychain storage, biometric authentication, jailbreak detection, sensitive-screen protection

- Honest mobile observability: crash-free rate, hang rate, cold start, per-endpoint latency — and acting on the numbers

- Mature the Android CI/CD pipeline: automated builds, signing, TestFlight, shortening commit-to-release time

- Release discipline: feature flags, staged rollout, genuinely tested rollback, and releasing outside exchange hours

- Work with compliance, risk, and security from the design stage rather than as a rubber stamp at the end

Qualifications:
- 5+ years of Android development, including at least 2 years carrying senior-level technical responsibility

- Modern concurrency: Kotlin Coroutines, Combine or equivalent

- Architecture at scale: MVVM / Clean Architecture, modularization, dependency injection — and the reasoning behind the choice

- Networking: URLSession, WebSockets, caching, graceful behaviour on poor connections

- Testing: unit, snapshot, and UI tests, with a clear point of view on what is worth testing

- Performance and memory profiling with Instruments

- Android CI/CD: Bitrise, or GitHub Actions

title: Digital Marketing Specialist

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description_text:
Pengembangan Mobile (Front-End):

- Merancang dan membangun aplikasi mobile cross-platform (Flutter / React Native) atau native (Android/iOS) yang responsif dan memiliki kinerja tinggi.

- Menerjemahkan desain UI/UX (Figma/Adobe XD) menjadi kode program yang bersih, modular, dan terstruktur.

- Mengoptimalkan performa aplikasi mobile (kecepatan rendering, efisiensi memori, dan penggunaan baterai).

Pengembangan Backend:

- Merancang, membangun, dan mengelola RESTful API / GraphQL yang aman dan scalable untuk mendukung fitur aplikasi mobile.

- Merancang struktur basis data (database schema) serta mengoptimalkan kueri data (SQL/NoSQL).

- Mengintegrasikan layanan pihak ketiga (third-party services) seperti payment gateway, push notification, lokasi/peta, dan analitik.

Infrastruktur & Publikasi:

- Mengelola proses rilis dan pembaruan aplikasi di Google Play Store dan Apple App Store.

- Menerapkan praktik CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) untuk otomatisasi pengujian dan deployment aplikasi mobile serta backend.

- Memantau, mendiagnosis, dan memperbaiki bug, kerentanan keamanan, serta kendala performa sistem secara berkala.

Kolaborasi & Tim:

- Bekerja sama dengan Product Manager, dan tim QA dalam siklus pengembangan bertahap (Agile/Scrum).

- Menulis dokumentasi teknis yang jelas untuk API, struktur basis data, dan arsitektur sistem.

Qualifications:
- Gelar Sarjana di bidang Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang relevan lainnya (pengalaman setara dapat dipertimbangkan).

- Pengalaman kerja minimal 3 tahun sebagai Full Stack Developer atau Mobile Developer yang memegang proyek end-to-end.

Keahlian Teknis Utama:

Mobile Development:

- Menguasai salah satu framework cross-platform utama: Flutter (Dart) atau React Native (JavaScript/TypeScript).

- Memahami konsep State Management (seperti BLoC/Provider untuk Flutter, atau Redux/Zustand untuk React Native).

- Memahami arsitektur native Android (Kotlin) atau iOS (Swift) merupakan nilai tambah yang kuat.

Backend Development:

- Menguasai minimal satu bahasa/framework backend: Node.js (Express/NestJS), Python (Django/FastAPI), Go, atau PHP (Laravel).

- Pengalaman luas dalam merancang dan mengonsumsi RESTful API dan/atau GraphQL.

Database Management:

- Pengalaman kerja dengan Relational Database (PostgreSQL, MySQL) dan NoSQL (MongoDB, Firebase Firestore, Redis).

Tools & DevOps:

- Terbiasa menggunakan Version Control System (Git & GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket).

- Pengalaman menggunakan layanan cloud (AWS, GCP, atau Firebase).

- Memahami proses rilis ke Google Play Console dan Apple App Store Connect.

Keahlian Non-Teknis (Soft Skills):

- Kemampuan pemecahan masalah (problem-solving) dan analisis logika yang kuat.

- Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik untuk berkolaborasi dalam tim lintas fungsi.

- Memiliki inisiatif tinggi, mandiri, dan terbiasa bekerja dalam lingkungan berbasis tenggat waktu (deadline).

Nilai Plus (Nice-to-Have)

- Pengalaman dengan pengujian otomatis (Unit Testing, Integration Testing, E2E Testing untuk mobile/backend).

- Pemahaman tentang konsep Microservices, Serverless Architecture, dan Docker.

- Menguasai framework web front-end (React.js, Vue.js, atau Next.js).

- Memiliki aplikasi mobile yang sudah dipublikasikan di Play Store / App Store (sertakan tautan portofolio/aplikasi).

title: Inventory Operations Associate
description_text:
About Astro

ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and backed by trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people’s lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced.

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

About the Role

As an Inventory Operations Associate, you’ll support the team in keeping inventory healthy and operations running smoothly. You’ll work with data to monitor stock movement, spot issues, and help the team find practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Monitor inbound, capacity, and outbound performance and highlight any gaps.

- Track inventory health, including DOI, bad stock, and stock movement.

- Help analyze inventory issues and support initiatives to reduce bad stock.

- Support capacity planning and inventory rebalancing across hubs.

- Follow up on pending SO/PO and other inventory movements.

- Support day-to-day inventory processes such as RTV, write-off, internal consumption, and backhaul.

- Help with ad-hoc analysis and operational requests when needed.

- Work closely with Supply Chain, Warehouse, and Hub teams to solve inventory-related issues.

Qualifications:
In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

- 1–3 years of experience in Inventory, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Logistics, or Operations.

- Comfortable working with numbers and data, especially Excel/Google Sheets.

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Detail-oriented and organized in following up on tasks.

- Willing to be hands-on and learn about inventory operations.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.

- SQL or BI tools experience is a plus

title: Dry Inventory Senior Supervisor
description_text:
About Astro

ASTRO - Groceries in Minutes

Indonesia's first and fastest-growing on-demand platform for groceries and essentials.

Anything you need, fast.

Astro is Indonesia's first quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Download our app now to experience and enjoy the new definition of fast!

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

About this Position

We are looking for a Dry Inventory Senior Supervisor who will be responsible for leading daily dry warehouse operations, ensuring inventory accuracy and flow, optimizing manpower productivity, and maintaining high standards of operational quality, safety, and service level.

Job Description

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Lead and supervise daily warehouse operations, ensuring inventory activities are executed accurately and efficiently.

- Oversee inbound, picking, packing, inventory, and outbound activities to ensure operational targets are achieved.

- Monitor inventory accuracy, picking accuracy, packing correctness, storage order, and loading readiness.

- Ensure smooth inventory flow and proactively resolve operational issues such as mispicks, missing items, and other inventory discrepancies.

- Evaluate operational workflows and identify opportunities to improve manpower productivity, inventory accuracy, and service level.

- Manage shift scheduling, manpower allocation, attendance, shift rotation, and backup planning to ensure sufficient manpower coverage.

- Delegate tasks and monitor team performance to ensure execution meets quality and productivity targets.

- Conduct daily operational reporting aligned with key KPIs, including output, errors, incidents, and attendance.

- Collaborate with Supply Chain and Category teams to resolve operational issues and support inventory forecasting.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across inventory flow and accuracy.

- Ensure compliance with SOP, health, hygiene, safety, security, and 5S standards.

- Maintain operational discipline and ensure the team consistently follows established warehouse procedures.

Qualifications:
Job Requirements

In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

- Minimum Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant educational background.

- Minimum 4–5 years of experience in warehousing or logistics operations.

- At least 2 years of experience at Supervisor level, with a minimum of 1 year at SPV level.

- Proven experience managing inventory accuracy and inventory flow in warehouse operations.

- Strong understanding of inventory management, including inventory control and accuracy.

- Solid knowledge of warehouse operations, particularly inbound, outbound, picking, packing, and inventory control.

- Familiarity with high-level racking systems and SPR processes.

- Understanding of health, safety, hygiene, security, and 5S standards.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and comfortable working with numbers and operational data.

- Familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).

- Basic data analysis skills, particularly for monitoring inbound performance, SLA, rejection rate, and productivity.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues.

- Strong execution and hands-on leadership in field operations.

- Clear and solid communication skills, with the ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders.

- High sense of urgency, strong ownership, and accountability.

- Detail-oriented, disciplined, and firm in enforcing operational standards and SOPs.

- Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced and dynamic warehouse environment.

title: Mitra Training & Program Officer
description_text:

The Hub Partner Training & Program Officer is responsible for driving partner (mitra) refreshment, retention, and training excellence. This role plays a key part in maintaining partner engagement while ensuring seamless alignment between training initiatives and hub operations.

title: Product Designer
description_text:
About Astro

ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced.

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

About this Position

We're looking for a Product Designer with a strong visual design taste, sharp product thinking, and a passion for crafting delightful user experiences. If you enjoy leveraging AI to accelerate your creative process, we'd love to meet you.

Responsibilities

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Own the end-to-end product design process, from discovery to final implementation.

- Conduct user research, field observations, and usability testing to uncover user needs.

- Design user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces for web and mobile products.

- Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.

- Continuously iterate designs based on user feedback, research findings, and product metrics.

- Maintain consistency by contributing to and utilizing design systems and UI guidelines.

- Prepare design assets and ensure smooth handoff to the engineering team.

- Leverage AI tools to accelerate design exploration, ideation, and productivity.

- Stay updated with emerging design trends, technologies, and best practices.

Qualifications:
In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

- 1-3 years of experience in Product Design, UI/UX Design, or a related field.

- Proven experience designing digital products for both web and mobile platforms.

- Strong understanding of UX principles, interaction design, visual design, and user-centered design methodologies.

- Proficient in Figma for interface design and prototyping.

- Experience conducting user research and usability testing.

- Comfortable making design decisions backed by user insights and data.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.

- Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Galileo AI, Uizard, or similar) to improve design workflows.

- Experience in e-commerce, logistics, or on-demand platforms is a plus.

- An active portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design projects is required.

- Menjalankan cost management dan mengidentifikasi peluang efisiensi maupun cost saving.

- Menyusun financial analysis yang membantu manajemen memahami kondisi bisnis dan mengambil keputusan.

How You Work

- Anda memiliki rasa tanggung jawab dan ownership yang tinggi terhadap pekerjaan.

- Anda teliti dan memahami bahwa detail kecil dalam proses keuangan dapat berdampak pada akurasi laporan dan kepatuhan perusahaan.

- Anda mampu menganalisis data, menemukan discrepancy, serta memastikan masalah ditindaklanjuti hingga selesai.

- Anda proaktif mencari cara untuk meningkatkan proses, sistem, dan financial control.

- Anda mampu berkomunikasi dengan jelas dan bekerja sama dengan internal team, management, auditor, maupun konsultan pajak.

What You’ll Enjoy as Our Team

- Incentives (monthly & quarterly)

- Tenure rewards & annual reviews

- Recognition & appreciation culture

- Well-being perks

- Your ideas matter and are rewarded

Qualifications:
Qualifications

- Berpengalaman dalam pengawasan atau optimalisasi ERP, khususnya Odoo, serta software perpajakan.

- Memiliki pengalaman dalam AR/AP management, transaction validation, reconciliation, dan cost management.

- Terbiasa bekerja dengan deadline ketat dalam proses pelaporan keuangan dan perpajakan.

- Menguasai Microsoft Excel dan/atau Google Sheets tingkat lanjut.

What Great Looks Like in This Role

- Accuracy & Deadline: Laporan keuangan tersaji secara akurat dan berbasis PSAK sesuai deadline, sementara pembayaran dan pelaporan pajak dilakukan sebelum jatuh tempo.

- Strong Tax Compliance: Seluruh pemotongan pajak vendor telah diverifikasi dan menggunakan tarif yang sesuai.

About the Role

We are looking for IT Procurement professionals across multiple capability levels, from Junior/Associate to Expert/Advisor, to support end-to-end procurement activities for IT and technology projects.

The role covers the full procurement lifecycle, including RFQ/RFP preparation, vendor sourcing, vendor comparison and evaluation, technical and commercial evaluation, TCO analysis, negotiation, contracting support, PO/procurement tracking, vendor management, reporting, strategic sourcing, category strategy, and procurement advisory.

Candidates may contribute at different levels, from hands-on procurement administration and operational support to strategic sourcing, negotiation, procurement governance, category strategy, and strategic procurement advisory. The position and level (L1–L5) will be determined based on the candidate's experience, capability, depth of IT/Technology Procurement expertise, and scope of responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

- Depending on the assigned level, responsibilities may include:

- Prepare and administer RFQ/RFP processes for IT and technology requirements.

- Identify, source, and manage potential vendors.

- Collect and maintain vendor data, documentation, quotations, and procurement records.

- Conduct vendor comparison and evaluation, including technical and commercial aspects.

- Perform commercial evaluation and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.

- Develop sourcing strategies and procurement approaches for IT projects.

- Conduct vendor assessment and due diligence.

- Lead or support commercial negotiations with vendors.

- Support contract preparation, review, and negotiation processes.

- Monitor and track Purchase Orders (PO), procurement status, and delivery milestones.

- Manage vendor relationships and performance.

- Prepare procurement reports, analysis, and management updates.

- Manage procurement-related stakeholder communication and escalation.

- Provide strategic procurement insights, benchmarking, and category strategy where applicable.

Capability Levels

L1 – Junior / Associate

- RFQ/RFP administration

- Vendor data and documentation management

- PO and procurement tracking

- Procurement reporting and administrative support

L2 – Professional / Specialist

- RFP preparation

- Vendor sourcing and comparison

- Technical and commercial evaluation

- TCO analysis

- Procurement analysis and recommendation

L3 – Senior Specialist

- Sourcing strategy

- Vendor assessment and selection

- Commercial negotiation

- End-to-end management of more complex IT procurement projects

- Stakeholder coordination

L4 – Manager / Lead

- IT procurement strategy

- Procurement governance and process management

- Stakeholder management

- Escalation management

- Strategic negotiation and contracting

- Leadership of procurement activities and teams

L5 – Expert / Advisor

- IT category strategy

- Strategic sourcing

- Industry benchmarking and market insight

- Strategic procurement advisory

- Complex procurement and commercial strategy

Qualifications:
Required Experience & Qualifications

- Experience in IT Procurement / Technology Procurement is required.

- Software / Application

- IT Infrastructure

- Hardware

- Cloud Services

- Software Licensing

- System Implementation

- Managed Services

- Data Center

- Network / Connectivity

- Other IT and technology-related products or services

- Strong understanding of vendor sourcing, evaluation, commercial analysis, and procurement processes.

- Strong analytical and negotiation skills.

- Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.

- Experience with procurement documentation, commercial evaluation, and contract/PO processes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with multiple vendors and managing competitive bidding processes.

title: Quality Audit Officer
description_text:
About Astro

ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced.

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

About this Position

We're looking for a Quality Audit Officer,, you'll be on the ground ensuring ASTRO Hub Kitchens consistently meet our food quality, safety, and Halal standards. You'll investigate quality issues, uncover root causes, and work closely with Operations to turn audit findings into practical improvements through CAPA.

Responsibilities

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Conduct quality audits across ASTRO Hub Kitchens to ensure compliance with internal SOPs, food safety, food quality, and Halal standards.

- Inspect raw materials, packaging, production processes, finished products, storage conditions, sanitation, hygiene, and GMP implementation.

- Perform basic quality checks, including pH, Brix, TDS, organoleptic assessment, visual inspection, and temperature monitoring.

- Identify and evaluate audit findings, then communicate issues and practical recommendations to Operations teams.

- Investigate customer complaints, product defects, rejects, and process deviations to identify root causes.

- Develop and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), including action plans, follow-ups, and closure status.

- Prepare accurate and objective audit reports and maintain proper documentation for each site visit.

- Conduct regular Hub visits and Mystery Shopper activities while maintaining confidentiality, objectivity, and integrity.

Qualifications:
In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Nutrition, Chemistry, Agriculture, or other relevant fields.

- 0-1 year of experience or internship in QA, QC, Quality Audit, Food Safety, or related functions is preferred.

- Basic knowledge of food safety and quality standards, including GMP, HACCP, hygiene, sanitation, and Halal/SJPH.

- Familiar with basic F&B quality checks such as pH, Brix, TDS, organoleptic assessment, and visual inspection.

- Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes.

- Detail-oriented, proactive, objective, and able to demonstrate strong integrity and communication skills.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets/Docs, and open to using AI tools to support daily work.

- Willing to work on-site and travel regularly across ASTRO Hub locations in Jabodetabek and other operational areas when required.

title: Procurement Supervisor
description_text:
About the Role

At Billstone, Procurement is more than finding a vendor and placing an order.

It is about making the right decision, balancing cost, quality, lead time, and business needs to ensure every purchase creates value for the company.

We are looking for a Procurement Supervisor who is confident in dealing with vendors, enjoys negotiation, pays attention to details, and can take ownership when things don't go according to plan.

In this role, you will work closely with vendors and different teams across Billstone, handle both routine and project-based procurement, and help improve the way we work.

If you enjoy turning procurement challenges into better deals, better processes, and better results, we'd love to meet you.

Outcomes You’ll Be Responsible For :

- Manage daily procurement activities, from sourcing and purchasing to vendor coordination and documentation.

- Source and evaluate vendors based on price, quality, specifications, capability, and lead time.

- Negotiate pricing, MOQ, payment terms, lead time, and other commercial terms.

- Monitor vendor performance and resolve quality issues, defects, claims, and delivery delays.

- Ensure PO and payment requests are accurate and properly processed in Odoo.

- Handle procurement needs from various departments, including project-based and urgent requests.

- Conduct product checks or vendor visits when required.

- Identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvement.

- Follow up on procurement issues and escalate major issues when necessary.

What Great Looks Like in This Role :

- Procurement runs accurately, efficiently, and on time.

- Vendors consistently deliver according to agreed cost, quality, and timeline.

- Better commercial terms and cost-saving opportunities are identified.

- Potential issues are spotted early and resolved before they impact operations.

- Internal teams can rely on Procurement to get things done.

- Procurement processes become simpler, faster, and more effective over time.

How You Work :

- You are confident in negotiation while maintaining strong vendor relationships.

- You make decisions based on cost, quality, lead time, and risk.

- You take ownership when things go wrong and focus on finding solutions.

- You are detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities.

- You follow up proactively and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

- You can adapt quickly when priorities change, including handling urgent requests.

- You are comfortable working both at your desk and on-site when needed.

What You’ll Enjoy as Our Team :

- Incentives (quarterly)

- Tenure rewards & annual reviews

- Recognition & appreciation culture

- Well-being perks

- Your ideas matter and are rewarded

All recruitment processes will be conducted online.

Qualifications:
- Experience as Senior Buyer, Senior Procurement Staff, Procurement Supervisor, or similar role is preferred.

- Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.

- Able to evaluate quotations, pricing, MOQ, payment terms, specifications, and lead time.

- Experience with Odoo or other ERP systems is preferred.

- Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

- Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Good command of English for written and verbal communication.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description_text:
AICines is four products in one: a streaming platform, an AI-powered social creation app, an AI creative studio where anyone can generate finished video from a prompt, and a film production house working with Hollywood studios on original content.

As a Data Analyst Intern, you'll work directly with product, growth, and content data from a live platform with real users. This is not sandboxed work — your analysis will inform decisions the team actually acts on.

Responsibilities:

- Build and maintain dashboards tracking user behaviour, retention, and engagement

- Write SQL queries against production data to answer product and growth questions

- Analyse acquisition channels, creator activity, and content performance

- Turn raw findings into clear, actionable recommendations for the team

- Support A/B tests and experiments from design through to readout

- Contribute to data quality and reporting standards as the platform scales

What you get:

- Fully remote with flexible working hours

- Direct mentorship from founders and senior engineers

- Hands-on exposure to production AI systems at consumer scale

- Progression based on impact rather than tenure

- Strong performers considered for full-time roles

Qualifications:
- Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction and analysis

- Familiarity with Python or R for data work (preferred, not mandatory)

- Strong proficiency in spreadsheets, including pivot tables and data visualisation

- Ability to communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders

- Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, asynchronous team

- Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a quantitative degree programme (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or similar)

- No prior professional experience required

description_text:
-

- Melaksanakan proses audit dari komunikasi awal dengan klien hingga penyusunan laporan audit.

Qualifications:
